tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database schema with products, categories, users, transactions, and alerts tables including indexes and relationships
Build Node.js/Express REST API with authentication, product CRUD endpoints, and transaction logging
Implement WebSocket server for real-time inventory updates and low stock alert broadcasting
Create React mobile-first UI with Dashboard Home, Products List, and Product Detail screens following design specifications
Integrate Barcode Scanner API and build Barcode Scanner screen with camera viewfinder and product lookup
Implement real-time inventory tracking logic with automatic stock updates on transactions and WebSocket sync across sessions
Build low stock alert system with database triggers, threshold checking, and Alerts & Notifications screen
Create Product Management functionality with add/edit/delete forms and validation matching acceptance criteria
Design and implement bottom navigation, reusable UI components (buttons, cards, modals), and responsive layouts
Build Sales Reporting screen with date filtering, revenue metrics, sales charts, and top products list
Implement user role-based access control for Store Owner, Store Manager, and Store Clerk permissions
Add accessibility features including WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, screen reader support, and keyboard navigation
Perform end-to-end testing of barcode scanning, inventory updates, and alert notifications across user sessions
Deploy MVP to staging environment and conduct user acceptance testing with store clerks and managers

risks: Barcode Scanner API integration may have compatibility issues across different mobile devices and browsers
WebSocket connection stability could be affected by network conditions in retail environments leading to sync failures
Real-time inventory updates under high transaction volume may cause database performance bottlenecks
Low stock alert threshold logic might generate excessive notifications if not properly tuned for business needs
Single-developer timeline may be tight for delivering all high-priority features within MVP sprint
